nodes.question: How do advanced systems improve data sharing and security?
nodes.answer: Advanced systems increase the sharing processes and security of data transmission.
nodes.paragraph: 2022 ; Cucchi et al. 2023 ). Specifically, DTs optimise the data acquisition, collection, and management pro- cesses, ensuring greater transparency and traceability (Zhang et al. 2020; Carri res et al. 2021; Mogos and Fragapane 2022; Sica et al. 2022). By implementing advanced systems, they also increase the sharing processes and security of data trans- mission (Huang et al. 2020 ; Sica et al. 2022 ; Dervishaj and Gudmundsson 2024). For instance, the inventory phase can benefit from digital technologies by gathering complete and accurate data, supporting decision-makers in identifying effec- tive solutions for reducing environmental impact (Zhang et al. 2020). Indeed, digital technologies, such as blockchain, have emerged in recent scientific contributions as a strong solution for developing a decentralised traceability system to record reliable, accountable, and up-to-date data along supply chains (Zhang et al. 2020; Carri res et al. 2021).
